samples: This program converts tabular data into formatted Markdown tables. It takes a table structure with a header row and body rows, calculates the width needed for each column based on its widest cell, and renders the entire table as Markdown-formatted text with properly aligned columns separated by pipes. When run, it demonstrates the functionality by printing a sample fruit price table.
